correctness.rationale: For any hypothetical three distinct prime-order sample zeros, the five unit-modulus coefficients enforce two quadratics F and G in the fourth root u over the cyclotomic integers. Exact reduction modulo (1-zeta_p) yields resultant 900, nonzero for all primes p>=7, contradiction. The two-root construction has explicit analytic discriminant sign bounds for p=7 and p>=11. p=5 has cyclotomic polynomial with four zeros. A standalone integer determinant check and 22 full-grid finite witness samples replayed successfully, not used as infinite proof.
